about: Real terrain around the base (Shackleton–de Gerlache ridge) for the 3D scenes. Label: measured (LRO LOLA heights) + computed (curvature drop r²/2R, the frame turn). Made by scripts/data/moon_terrain.py.

source.credit: Heights: NASA LRO LOLA, NASA GSFC Planetary Geodesy Data Archive (Barker et al. 2021, 2023).

frame.note: map +y (lunar longitude 0, toward Earth) is turned to Earth's azimuth in oy_sky
